english.title: Supply / sell etc prescribed medicinal product without authority
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) in the course of business carried on by you

(A)_[sold]_
(B)_[procured the sale of]_
(C)_[supplied]_
(D)_[procured the supply of]_
(E)_[manufactured]_
(F)_[procured the manufacture of]_
(G)_[assembled]_
(H)_[procured the assembly of]_

a relevant medicinal product, namely **(..SPECIFY..), knowing or having reasonable cause to believe that the product was or was intended to be placed on the market without holding a Community or United Kingdom marketing authorisation for that product
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraphs 2 and 14 of Schedule 3 to the Medicines for Human Use (Marketing Authorisations etc) Regulations 1994.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence relates to prescribed drugs which are NOT CONTROLLED by the the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971.
(ii) See offence wording H3630 for possession of relevant medicinal product knowing etc that it was/intended for supply without relevant marketing authorisation.
(iii) The Medicines Control Agency (MCA) is responsible for the enforcement of medicines legislation in the United Kingdom. The MCA is an executive agency of the Department of Health whose primary objective is to safeguard public health by ensuring that all medicines on the UK market meet appropriate standards safety, quality and efficacy. The MCA have an intelligence unit Tel 0207 2730617 and will assist with queries.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
